correctness.rationale: The bilinear multiplication reduction H(u)=tu and F^TBG=tB is an equivalence. Both invertible input maps preserve the bilinear radical, so block decomposition yields a unique free parameter scheme. A block inverse-transpose identity determines the second nondegenerate block. Shears give a normal additive subgroup, split by the general linear diagonal blocks and common multiplier. Counting independent finite-field parameters and dimensions yields the exact formulas in every characteristic. Actual exhaustive finite-field tests over prime fields in dimensions 1–3, both generator positions, and a nonscalar Gram block returned VERIFY_OK; finite tests are corroboration, not general proof.
